item.title: Huge fire in Scotland triggers train chaos as historic building partially collapses
item.description: A massive fire near one of Scotland s busiest train stations has engulfed a historic building in Glasgow, causing it to partially collapse. MORE..

item.title: Ex-Ministers Mahindananda and Nalin Fernando produced before court
item.description: Former ministers Mahindananda Aluthgamage and Nalin Fernando, who were sentenced to rigorous imprisonment and appealed against their convictions on corruption charges, have been produced before the Supreme Court by prison officials. MORE..

item.title: Sri Lanka in “much better position” to handle oil price shocks - CBSL Governor
item.description: The Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe has assured the public that Sri Lanka is now in a “much better position” to withstand global economic shocks, including rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. MORE..

item.title: Bus strike on 143 Hanwella–Colombo route
item.description: Private bus operators on the Hanwella–Colombo Route (143) have reportedly commenced a strike. MORE..

item.title: CEB dissolved; six new companies take over operations
item.description: The six new companies established through the dissolution of the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) have officially come into effect today (09), following the conclusion of the Board s tenure as of midnight yesterday. MORE..

item.title: IMF warns war could push global inflation higher
item.description: The International Monetary Fund is warning the Middle East conflict poses risks for global inflation and has made energy security a top concern. MORE..

item.title: Oil is now up 25% and on track for a record daily jump
item.description: Oil prices surged more than 25% on Monday to their highest levels since mid-2022. MORE..

item.title: PM Harini departs for Manila to attend ADB International Women s Day events
item.description: The Prime Minister of Sri Lanka, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, departed for Manila, Philippines, at midnight yesterday (8 March) to undertake an official visit at the invitation of the Asian Development Bank (ADB), to participate in events marking International Women s Day. MORE..

item.title: G7 to discuss joint release of emergency oil reserves
item.description: G7 finance ministers will discuss a possible joint release of petroleum from reserves co-ordinated by the International Energy Agency, in an emergency meeting on Monday aimed at tackling the surge in oil prices following the conflict in the Gulf. MORE..

item.title: Youth arrested with Ice during vehicle inspection in Dodangoda
item.description: During a vehicle inspection operation conducted under the island-wide anti-drug operation, a suspect involved in Crystal Methamphetamine (commonly known as Ice ) drug trafficking across Dodangoda and surrounding areas has been arrested by Dodangoda Police. MORE..
